title: File Input/Output Operations
summary: This module demonstrates basic file input and output capabilities by writing and reading data in both JSON and CSV formats to temporary files.

nodes.label: Orchestrate File I/O
nodes.title: Main I/O Orchestrator
nodes.description: The primary function that orchestrates the creation, writing, and reading of temporary JSON and CSV files to demonstrate I/O capabilities.

nodes.label: Manage Temporary Directory
nodes.title: Temporary Directory Manager
nodes.description: Manages the lifecycle of a temporary directory, ensuring files are created and cleaned up within a controlled environment.

nodes.label: Write JSON Data
nodes.title: JSON File Writer
nodes.description: Serializes Python dictionaries into JSON format and writes the structured data to a specified temporary file.

nodes.label: Read JSON Data
nodes.title: JSON File Reader
nodes.description: Reads and deserializes JSON data from a specified temporary file back into Python dictionaries for processing.

nodes.label: Write CSV Data
nodes.title: CSV File Writer
nodes.description: Writes tabular data, represented as rows of dictionaries, into a CSV file with appropriate headers.

nodes.label: Read CSV Data
nodes.title: CSV File Reader
nodes.description: Reads tabular data from a CSV file, parsing each row into a structured format, typically a dictionary.

nodes.label: JSON Output File
nodes.title: Temporary JSON File
nodes.description: A temporary file used as an intermediary storage for JSON formatted data during I/O operations.

nodes.label: CSV Output File
nodes.title: Temporary CSV File
nodes.description: A temporary file used as an intermediary storage for CSV formatted data during I/O operations.
